name: District Electoral Areas 1992 (provisional recommendations)
description: The 101 district electoral areas the District Electoral Areas Commissioner provisionally recommended on 20 August 1992, with each area's wards and electors on the February 1991 register. 90 areas went through unchanged to the final scheme (District Electoral Areas 1993). Coleraine West was renamed Coleraine Central, and the groupings in Ballymena, Carrickfergus, Magherafelt and Strabane were revised after public inquiries. Built by grouping OSNI's 1993 wards as the report lists them.

references.label: District Electoral Areas Commissioner: Provisional Recommendations, Local Government District Electoral Areas (August 1992)
references.note: Published 20 Aug 1992 with four maps; Appendix I lists each district electoral area with its wards and number of electors. Printed report; no online copy found.

references.label: Recommendations for the Grouping of Wards into District Electoral Areas for the purpose of Local Government Elections in Northern Ireland: Report by the District Electoral Areas Commissioner, Dr Maurice Hayes (Belfast: HMSO, December 1992)
references.note: Section 8 sets out the revisions to the provisional recommendations in Ballymena, Carrickfergus, Coleraine (name only), Magherafelt and Strabane; the other 21 districts were carried through unchanged.

references.label: OSNI Open Data - Largescale Boundaries - Wards (1993)
references.note: Ward geometry grouped to form the provisional areas.
